title: Degree-Wise Obstruction Calculus and Symbolic DSL: Graded Cochain Complexes, Degree Separation, and Local-Global Gate Non-Factorization
description:
Version: v2.1.0 (2026-09-30).

Abstract. The obstruction DSL is a typed graded symbolic system: d0: C0 → C1 and d1: C1 → C2 act on distinct cochain degrees, and the diagnostic carried by d1 (the closure defect Γ2) is provably invisible to any model that supplies only C1 data with no explicit 2-cell structure. Valid expressions must respect degree typing and ℓ1(E;g) aggregation; collapsing degrees or relaxing the norm destroys recoverable obstruction information. The same finite replay now also has a composite LGGR form: even a local fingerprint that remembers both C1 edge data and whether the DSL diagnostic is constructible does not determine the global gated pair consisting of Γ2 and acceptance authorization. This boundary is stable under context extension: adding arbitrary external metadata does not repair the PrimitiveDifference non-factorization unless the missing global gate itself is supplied.

Artifacts. The deposit contains the complete research monograph in Markdown, XeLaTeX, and vector PDF; a verified Python computational engine operating under exact rational arithmetic with 21 passing tests; Lean 4 mechanized formalizations compiling under Lake with zero sorries; interactive Jupyter reproduction notebooks; and deterministic deposit verification tooling.

Reproduction.

python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
python verify_deposit.py
